scripts.i18n: npm run i18n-pot && npm run i18n-json && npm run i18n-mo
scripts.build: rm -rf i18n && NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider wp-scripts build && npm run i18n && find . -name '.DS_Store' -delete && npm run zip
scripts.zip: mkdir -p zip && zip -r zip/pdf-poster.zip admin assets build i18n img inc vendor blocks.php pdf-poster.php upgrade.php readme.txt
scripts.zip:temp: mkdir -p zip && zip -r zip/pdf-poster.zip build i18n img inc shortcode vendor blocks.php pdf-poster.php upgrade.php readme.txt
